entities.name: GraphJournal
entities.description: Per-graph canonical transactional event store. Tracker intent, task directories, snapshots, factory telemetry and static plans are imports, outboxes or projections, never competing execution truth.

fields.name: journal_seq
fields.notes: Advances for every durable event, including normalized rejection decisions and evidence; maximum is SQLite signed 64-bit.

fields.name: graph_revision
fields.notes: Advances only for accepted state affecting readiness, authority, routing, leases, budgets, candidates or topology; maximum is SQLite signed 64-bit.

fields.name: previous_record_hash
fields.notes: The genesis record uses 64 lowercase zero hex characters.

fields.name: schedule_hash
fields.notes: Covers nodes, schedulable edges, outcomes, controls, leases, resources, budgets, provider-policy snapshot and logical-time observations.

fields.name: audit_state_hash
fields.notes: Additionally covers relations, evidence provenance, decisions, routing and candidate disposition.

fields.name: payload
fields.notes: Arbitrary raw tool output and credentials are prohibited; redactor version and policy hash are pinned.

preconditions.description: The caller holds the exclusive SQLite write transaction and the envelope base revision equals the current graph revision.
The envelope is bounded, version-recognized and safely decodable into either a mutation candidate or a typed rejection envelope before the transaction commits.

postconditions.description: Exactly one hash-chained event commits atomically and accepted graph effects become visible together.
Rejected decisions advance journal_seq but not graph_revision; accepted state changes advance both exactly once.
postconditions.expression: decision.rejected implies revision_unchanged and decision.accepted implies graph_revision == old_revision + 1

error_cases.condition: base revision is stale
schema, authority, cycle, evidence, terminal-state or semantic validation fails
exclusive writer transaction cannot be acquired
transaction durability cannot be established

derived_from.description: Atomic CAS, replay, crash recovery and hashing

preconditions.description: The tracker adapter reports capability and scan status and supplies a source revision/hash; malformed or unavailable input is not interpreted as an empty graph.

postconditions.description: Human intent remains tracker/ratchet authoritative and is imported one-way as immutable version-bound facts.

error_cases.condition: source status or digest is absent

preconditions.description: Intent compilation has a verified source status and ticket-level projection is possible.

postconditions.description: The projection is byte-equivalent to plan_waves.py for all six fields waves, gated, skipped, warnings, integration_risks and gate_reasons, with exit 0 success, 1 invalid input and 2 cycle.

error_cases.condition: intent scan is unavailable, degraded, malformed or unscanned
ticket projection is undefined or dependency input is invalid/corrupt
cycle exists across projected dependency nodes

invariants.description: A complete well-formed record with a bad hash or any mid-journal corruption fails closed; recovery discards only an uncommitted partial tail transaction.

derived_from.description: CAS requires serialized durable commit; SQLite selected over bespoke JSONL

entities.name: ExecutionControl
entities.description: Execution node, mutation approval, lease, attempt outcome, candidate disposition and evidence lifecycle facts from which readiness is derived.

fields.name: attempt_outcome
fields.notes: Outcome is terminal and orthogonal to candidate disposition.

fields.name: ready
fields.notes: Never independently mutated or journaled as authority.

preconditions.description: All decision inputs are from the pinned journal projection, including logical ticks, provider health, budgets, policy, leases and resources.
preconditions.expression: all(inputs in journal_projection for inputs in readiness_inputs)

postconditions.description: A node is ready iff admitted, nonterminal, all schedulable predecessors succeeded, no active block/control constraint exists, resources and provider capabilities are claimable, and retry/budget limits allow dispatch.
postconditions.expression: ready(n) == admitted(n) and nonterminal(n) and all(pred_succeeded(p) for p in predecessors(n)) and no_block(n) and resources_claimable(n) and provider_eligible(n) and budget_allows(n)

error_cases.condition: a required readiness input is unavailable or unscanned

preconditions.description: The node is currently ready, the next lease epoch is atomically allocated, and all shared mutable resources are claimable.
preconditions.expression: ready(node) and epoch == prior_epoch + 1 and resources_claimable(node)

postconditions.description: Claim acquisition and dispatch-request outbox event commit atomically before process launch; every result and Git action must present the current fencing token.

error_cases.condition: node no longer ready or resource/lease collision
stale worker presents an older lease epoch

preconditions.description: All candidates have terminal attempt outcomes, the chosen candidate succeeded and passed the frozen independent verifier, isolation is proven, and the group has no winner.
preconditions.expression: all_terminal(group) and chosen.outcome == 'succeeded' and verifier_passed(chosen, group.verifier_hash) and isolation_proven(group) and group.winner == null

postconditions.description: One atomic event marks exactly one candidate promoted and all other eligible candidates superseded without changing immutable attempt outcomes.

error_cases.condition: winner already exists, graph revision is stale, or candidates are not all terminal
verifier hash, independence, identity blinding or isolation proof fails
chosen candidate did not succeed/pass hard gates or all candidates failed hard gates

preconditions.description: An authenticated runtime operator supplies identity, exact action, non-empty reason and the current base revision.
preconditions.expression: operator.authenticated and action in ('pause','resume','cancel') and reason != '' and base_revision == current_revision

postconditions.description: The action is journaled; a running worker pauses or cancels only after a safe commit boundary and lease release/revocation.
postconditions.expression: journaled(action) and terminal_control implies worker_quiescent and lease_inactive

error_cases.condition: action is unknown or reason is empty
operator identity is absent
base revision is stale
safe boundary not yet reached

entities.name: ProviderExecutionDecision
entities.description: Model-agnostic capability routing and agentic worker execution record; provider roles remain configuration, not hard-coded workflow branches.

fields.name: metadata
fields.notes: Contains no credentials, raw secrets or absolute home paths.

preconditions.description: Required capabilities, budget, health observations, objective escalation evidence and provider policy are pinned by digest.
preconditions.expression: all(hash_pinned(x) for x in (requirements, budget, health, evidence, policy))

postconditions.description: Selection is deterministic, cheapest capable first, escalation requires an objective trigger, and the author and verifier independence groups differ.
postconditions.expression: deterministic(selection) and cheapest_capable_first and (escalated implies objective_trigger) and author.independence_group != verifier.independence_group

error_cases.condition: any decision input is not content-hash pinned
no independent verifier or capable fallback exists
node or graph budget cannot fund the route

preconditions.description: Execution is in a verified non-main worktree with workspace-write sandbox; a trusted orchestrator resolves the key through a command-backed helper outside the model-controlled workspace.
preconditions.expression: assert_worktree() and not_main_checkout and sandbox == 'workspace-write' and credential_helper_not_invokable_by_model

postconditions.description: Success atomically publishes schema-valid metadata, result, log and DONE; failure publishes ERROR with one stable reason; DONE and ERROR are mutually exclusive.
postconditions.expression: success implies files == required_success_files and xor(exists(DONE), exists(ERROR))

error_cases.condition: credential missing or helper boundary unsafe
main checkout or unsupported tool/model behavior
worker timeout
non-zero exit, malformed stream or missing result

invariants.description: Any anonymous preview without recorded public weights and license evidence is classified external-preview-tier, never open-tier; specific slugs remain configuration/manifest data only.
invariants.expression: anonymous_preview(provider) and not public_weights_license_evidence(provider) implies provider.tier == 'external-preview-tier'

derived_from.description: Codex Responses tool call succeeded but model metadata fell back and input usage was unusually high

entities.name: ExperimentRun
entities.description: Pre-registered, immutable, budget-matched comparison of orchestration and provider-policy factors with causal claims limited to the randomized factors actually crossed.

preconditions.description: Pre-registration predates all runs and fixes corpus strata, factorial cells, deterministic blocked-randomization/interleaving algorithm, assignment unit/log, budgets, tools, sandbox, verifier, seeds, stopping rules, non-inferiority margin, gap formula and degenerate cases.

postconditions.description: Every run publishes an immutable manifest and raw result bound to the ratchet journal; headline slices include N and confidence intervals and retain protocol violations and negative results.
postconditions.expression: immutable(manifest, raw_results) and ratchet_bound and all(headline.has_n_and_ci) and negative_results_retained

error_cases.condition: pre-registration, randomized assignment/interleaving, contamination, budget matching, verifier freeze or manifest completeness fails

invariants.description: The primary design is a crossed orchestration × provider-policy factorial where feasible; if cells are missing or observational, report associations only and do not attribute a model effect to the DAG or a DAG effect to the model.
